title: UTIITSL Form 94 FAQs (Indian Entity)
text:
--- Page 1 ---
Form 94 – Non-Individual (Entity):
1. What is Form 94?
Ans: Form 94 is a PAN Application form for Indian Company or an Entity incorporated in
India or an unincorporated entity formed in India.
2. Who should apply using Form 94?
Ans: Any Indian company, LLP, Firm, Trust, HUF, AOP, BOI and AJP
incorporated/formed in India can apply for PAN by filing Form 94.
3. What documents are required for Form 94?
Ans: The prescribed documents are mentioned in sub Rule 8(b) of Rule 158 of IT Rules,
2026.
4. Can communication address be different from office address?
Ans: Yes, however in such case the applicant has to submit the proof of address for
such communication address.
